# Data Capture Tool

> Local Flask + plain-JS app that captures one clean training image per vehicle from live RTSP camera streams,
> only while the vehicle is inside user-drawn ROI polygons. Any YOLO model (custom or COCO), multi-GPU, no
> database (JSON + image files). Browser UI: Live view with recent captures, ROI editor, cameras, gallery, settings.

Key facts for tools and agents:
- Run: `python backend/app.py` (port 5100). Tests: `python -m pytest` (integration needs ../vedio and ../models).
- State: `config.ini` (settings), `data/cameras.json` (cameras + `rois`), `captures/<cam>/<date>/frame|crop/*.jpg`.
- Backend in `backend/`, frontend in `frontend/`. No build step, no database.
- Duplicate protection: track lock + ID-switch guard (IoU/pHash against recently active saves only).
- Settings apply only when the user presses "Save & restart" (one restart, counters + images kept).
- Live tab: Start all / Stop all, cameras-per-row layout, per-camera full screen, recent-captures panel.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): install, usage, every setting, troubleshooting
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules, capture logic, restart flow, data formats, threading
- [HTTP API](docs/API.md): every endpoint with request/response shapes
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): conventions, test commands, gotchas for AI coding assistants

## Code map
- [backend/app.py](backend/app.py): Flask app factory, REST API, MJPEG stream, restart-on-settings-change
- [backend/capture_engine.py](backend/capture_engine.py): CaptureLogic, YoloDetector, LatestFrameReader, CameraWorker
- [backend/dedup.py](backend/dedup.py): duplicate suppression
- [backend/roi.py](backend/roi.py): polygon / mask helpers (multi-ROI)
- [backend/storage.py](backend/storage.py): cameras.json store, image saving, gallery, recent, thumbnails
- [backend/settings.py](backend/settings.py): config.ini load/save with validation
- [backend/devices.py](backend/devices.py): GPU detection and camera-to-device assignment
- [backend/camera_io.py](backend/camera_io.py): safe camera access (port check, timeouts)
- [frontend/index.html](frontend/index.html): single page; scripts in frontend/static/js/
- [backend/tests/](backend/tests/): pytest suite (unit, API with fake worker, real-model integration)
